newsitem.title: USA: CAI agreement with Bells suspended 1 year.
newsitem.headline: CAI agreement with Bells suspended 1 year.

text.p: Bell Atlantic Corp, Nynex Corp and CAI Wireless Systems Inc suspended their 1995 agreement to develop wireless video networks for one year, Bell Atlantic said.
The move clears way for CAI to better develop its Multichannel Multipoint Distribution Service (MMDS) transport systems, Bell Atlantic said.

Under a new agreement, CAI has the option to repurchase a $100 million investment in CAI securities made by Bell Atlantic and Nynex. Officials from the companies were not immedietaly available to comment.
